title: What the live paper record shows
description: The engines' own state, read from the running record: what is open, what closed, and what the market filter is doing right now.
body:
Every position in this record is paper. No real orders are placed anywhere in this record. One trade does not say anything about a strategy, and the current live sample is small. The engines' own state is read from the running record: what is open, what closed, and what the market filter is doing right now. The numbers below are the same numbers that appear on the performance page, in the signal log, and in the status posted to the channel.

## Live starts and the first closed trade

trend-daily-v005 counts its live record from 1 October 2026 and trend-daily-v006 from 9 October 2026. The first live signal was an ATOM entry at 2.066 after the 10 October 2026 daily close. ATOM exited below its 10-day low at the 18 October 2026 close, at 1.703, which is −17.9% after the 30 bps round trip. The exit condition was a close below the 10-day low, and the measured outcome of that single closed trade is −17.9% after the 30 bps round trip. A NEAR entry at 5.896 on 12 October 2026 has been open since. In testing, most trades lost and the average winner was roughly +19%, so a losing start is the expected case rather than a surprise. The live record therefore begins with one closed loss and one open position. One trade does not say anything about a strategy.

## Open positions and recent closed trades

htf-rsi-v007 shows 0 positions open on paper and 4 closed trades so far, with an average null net per trade. The reported average is null, not a numeric percentage, so no net average percentage is shown for those 4 closed trades. trend-daily-v005 shows the Bitcoin market filter on, 0 positions open on paper, and 5 closed trades so far, with an average -13.68% net per trade. trend-daily-v006 shows the Bitcoin market filter on, 1 position open on paper, and 5 closed trades so far, with an average -13.68% net per trade. Its open position is HYPEUSDT, open since 2026-10-30T00:00:00.000Z. Across the engines listed above, HYPEUSDT is the only open paper position. Both trend-daily engines report the same closed-trade average of -13.68% net per trade over 5 closed trades each. These are reported measurements from the running record, not evaluations of either engine.

## What the market filter is allowing

With the Bitcoin market filter on for both trend-daily engines, the record shows no new paper positions beyond the one already open in v006. For trend-daily-v005, the names closest to their 20-day breakout are:

- UNIUSDT is 5.87% below its high.
- BCHUSDT is 6.65% below its high.
- BNBUSDT is 7.98% below its high.

For trend-daily-v006, the names closest to their 20-day breakout are:

- UNIUSDT is 5.87% below its high.
- HYPEUSDT is 6.50% below its high.
- BCHUSDT is 6.65% below its high.

In both lists, each name is below its high, so the breakout condition has not been met for any of them. A paper position is not opened on a name until it reaches its breakout level, and these distances show that none of the listed names has done so. The filter state and the distance-to-high measurements are the current inputs; they do not imply what will happen next.

## How to read the closed-trade averages

htf-rsi-v007 reports 4 closed trades with an average null net per trade, so no numeric average is available for that engine. trend-daily-v005 and trend-daily-v006 each report 5 closed trades with an average -13.68% net per trade. Those averages are measurements of the closed trades already recorded, not forecasts for open or future trades. ATOM is one closed trade at −17.9% after the 30 bps round trip, and NEAR remains open at its 5.896 entry. The record is small, and one trade does not say anything about a strategy. In testing, most trades lost and the average winner was roughly +19%, so a losing start is the expected case rather than a surprise.

## Record status

This live snapshot was read at 2026-11-03T14:22:21.564Z. The record updates continuously. The same numbers appear on the performance page, in the signal log, and in the status posted to the channel. Paper signals only. No real orders are placed anywhere in this record.
